subject: Lumenity RFP: request for evaluation credits and pilot support
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lumenity.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lumenity RFP -- request for evaluation credits and pilot support

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Lumenity has an upcoming vendor bake-off tied to an RFP (deadline 2026-09-20) and procurement asked me to formalize the request for evaluation resources. High level: we need a short-term environment to validate latency and hallucination characteristics against our clinical QA set.

As discussed, can Redwood provide a time-bound allocation we can use for a 2-week hands-on bake-off? Our ask is in the neighborhood of 100k generation tokens + 8k embedding units and a contact for ops support if we hit throttling. We also need a short MOU that outlines data handling and expiry of artifacts.

Please include any program terms and the expected timeline for activation. If there are any approvals needed from your side, call those out and we'll circulate internally to expedite.

Tom Reyes
Head of ML Engineering | Lumenity
Tom.Reyes@lumenity.com
procurement@lumenity.com

(On a related note, procurement flagged that several competitors are offering trial boosts — procurement will include that as leverage in negotiations.)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lumenity.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenity RFP -- request for evaluation credits and pilot support

Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We can support a bake-off like this; I'll loop in Priyom for allocation authority and Rafael for ops/activation so we can pin a target delivery.

Two quick questions to help size the allocation: do you anticipate heavy long-context evaluation ( > 2k tokens per request) or mostly short prompts with many examples? Also, will you need per-tenant isolation or is a shared sandbox acceptable for this trial?

If you can send the MOU template procurement prefers, that will speed the legal/ops side. We'll aim for an initial response with a proposed allocation + terms within 24 business hours.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
555-703-1421

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, tom.reyes@lumenity.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenity RFP -- request for evaluation credits and pilot support

Kim / Tom —

Thanks for the details. Per the ask, I'm prepared to approve a conditional evaluation allocation but with a few guardrails to protect platform economics and compliance:

- Allocation: 60,000 generation tokens + 5,000 embedding units
- Duration: 30 days from activation
- Data handling: all uploaded datasets are ephemeral; we require a signed MOU or purchase order confirming data deletion at expiry
- Support: standard onboarding via Rafael (ops) with 2x check-ins during the trial window

If Lumenity can sign an MOU (draft attached "Lumenity_MOU_draft.docx") and confirm that average context length is under 2k tokens, we can provision within 48 hours. If procurement insists on parity with competitor offers, provide the competitor reference and we can escalate.

Priyom Das
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: Lumenity_MOU_draft.docx

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lumenity.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenity.com
Date: 2026-09-02T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenity RFP -- request for evaluation credits and pilot support

Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft MOU. Procurement pushed back on the initial allocation as insufficient relative to the scope of our tests (we're planning repeated runs across a 25k-record QA set and multiple prompt variants). They're asking whether Redwood can stretch to 100k generation tokens and 8k embedding units, at least for a 21-day window.

From our side we can sign the MOU and confirm a context target of ~1.2k tokens on average. If you can offer a short escalation cadence and one-time extension option (in case we need to rerun a subset), that would be ideal. Also please include a single-point-of-contact for rate-limit triage during the bake-off.

Tom

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenity RFP -- request for evaluation credits and pilot support

Looping in for approval — happy to make an exception here given Lumenity's fit and the size of the potential ARR. Approve an increase to 90,000 generation tokens + 8,000 embedding units (21 days). Conditions: we require the signed MOU before activation and a HubSpot activity logged with deal id DL-2026-089. Priyom — please provision and mark "trial_terms_lumenity.pdf" in the customer record. Rafael, assign an ops lead and share on-call details with Tom.

Once MOU is returned, Sales ops should provision immediately. If procurement still insists on 100k, escalate to Legal+Finance for a one-time top-up decision.

-Markus Klein
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
